This generic Mathlib corner-map theorem supplies that restriction, not a new compact-support route.

title: Fibrations of internal homs along monomorphisms
statement: Use small simplicial sets, internal functor simplicial sets and horns as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones]. Let $i:C\hookrightarrow L$ be a degreewise injective simplicial map, and let $p:E\to B$ be a Kan fibration, meaning a simplicial map with the right lifting property against every horn inclusion $\Lambda_k^n\hookrightarrow\Delta^n$ for $n\geq1$ and $0\leq k\leq n$. Then the natural restriction/postcomposition map $$\operatorname{Fun}(L,E)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Fun}(C,E)\times_{\operatorname{Fun}(C,B)}\operatorname{Fun}(L,B),\qquad h\longmapsto(h\circ i,p\circ h),$$ is a Kan fibration. The pullback is degreewise. No Kan assumption on $B$ or on $C,L$ is imposed.
